point_in_time.content_reproduced: statutory text of historical redactions (answer and distractors)
point_in_time.label_quality: structural: the answer is the redaction whose RT validity window contains the query date; exactly one redaction must cover that date

court_interpretation.content_reproduced: case number, ECLI, decision date, chamber, interpreted provision IRIs
court_interpretation.label_quality: silver: estleg:interpretsLaw edges come from the regex citation resolver over the decision text (src/estleg/extract_court_provision_links.py); a cited provision counts as interpreted
court_interpretation.default_exclusions: criminal and misdemeanour cases (estleg:CaseType_Criminal / _Misdemeanor): a case number linked to Penal Code provisions is offence-related data under Art. 10 GDPR; re-include only with --include-criminal after DPO sign-off

rights.source_text: Riigikohus / RIK judgments are not objects of copyright (Autoriõiguse seadus § 5); no judgment text is reproduced

cross_reference.content_reproduced: the citation string (a short span of statutory text) and provision IRIs
